[[File:Wii-Console.png|alt=|thumb|Wii console with [[Wii Remote]]]]
This is a list of video games for the [[Wii]] [[video game console]] that have sold or shipped at least one million copies. The best-selling game on the Wii is ''[[Wii Sports]]''. First released in North America on November 19, 2006, it was a launch title for the system and was [[pack-in game|bundled]] with the Wii console in all regions except Japan and South Korea. The game went on to sell nearly 82.90 million units worldwide making it the [[list of best-selling video games|Third-best-selling video game of all time]] and is also the best-selling game released on a single console.<ref name="110425e">{{cite web|url=https://www.nintendo.co.jp/ir/pdf/2011/110425e.pdf|title=Earnings Release: Fiscal Year Ended March 31, 2011|date=April 26, 2011|access-date=April 26, 2011|publisher=[[Nintendo]]|page=16}}</ref> ''[[Mario Kart Wii]]'' is the second-best-selling game on the platform with sales of 37.38 million units. It is the second-best-selling iteration in the ''[[Mario Kart]]'' series behind ''[[Mario Kart 8 Deluxe]]''. The third-best-selling game is ''[[Wii Sports Resort]]'', a sequel to ''Wii Sports'', with sales of 33.14{{nbsp}}million units. The console's top five is rounded out by ''[[New Super Mario Bros. Wii]]'', which sold 30.32{{nbsp}}million units and ''[[Wii Play]]'', which sold just over 28{{nbsp}}million units worldwide.

There are a total of 64 Wii games on this list which are confirmed to have sold or shipped at least one million units. Of these, 21 were developed by internal Nintendo development divisions. Other developers with the most million-selling games include [[Ubisoft Paris]] with five games and [[Capcom]] and [[Sega Sports R&D]], with three games each on the list. Of the 64 games on this list, 42 were published in one or more regions by Nintendo. Other publishers with multiple million-selling games include [[Ubisoft]] with six games and [[Activision]] and Capcom with three games each. The best selling franchises on the Wii include the [[Wii (video game series)|''Wii'' video game series]] (157.53{{nbsp}}million combined units), ''[[Super Mario]]'' (53.77 million combined units), and ''[[The Legend of Zelda]]'' (16.96 million combined units).

By March 31, 2021, over 921.85{{nbsp}}million total copies of games had been sold for the Wii.<ref name="totalwiisales">{{cite web |url=https://www.nintendo.co.jp/ir/en/finance/hard_soft/index.html |title=Dedicated Video Game Sales Units |access-date=January 30, 2020|date=December 31, 2019 |website=[[Nintendo]]}}</ref> By December 31, 2007, sales of [[Virtual Console]] games had reached over 10{{nbsp}}million copies.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.gamespot.com/news/6185358.html|title=Q&A: Nintendo's Satoru Iwata|author1=Yohei Ogawa |author2=Randolph Ramsay |author3=Tor Thorsen |publisher=[[GameSpot]]|date=February 5, 2008|access-date=February 6, 2008}}</ref> As of March 31, 2019, there are a total of 103 Wii games that have sold at least one million units.<ref name="110425e"/>
